literal: To speak many things they will desire, surely, those who have not mastered speaking a few flawless words.
translation: Those who do not know how to speak a few flawless words will surely desire to speak many words.
modern: குற்றமற்ற சில சொற்களைச் சொல்லத் தெரியாதவர்கள், பல சொற்களைப் பேச விரும்புவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the beauty of concise, flawless speech with the tendency of untrained speakers to babble. The phrase 'மாசற்ற சில சொல்லல்' refers to the art of speaking a few words that are completely free of errors or blemishes. Those who have not mastered this art ('தேற்றாதவர்') will surely ('மன்ற') desire ('காமுறுவர்') to speak at great length ('பல சொல்ல'), mistakenly believing that quantity can compensate for a lack of quality.
